description: Use this when someone wants one of the articles from gather_what_to_publish or gather_this_week written: GatherHQ drafts it in the brand's look and voice from the buyers' own words and the brief, checks its quotes and numbers against them, and keeps it in the GatherHQ Content Library to edit, download or publish. It takes 2 to 4 minutes: each call waits a while for it, so call again with the same suggestion_id until it is drafted, without writing to the person in between. It never writes a second draft of the same suggestion; one that failed is written again. Not for answers for the Resources Page, or for content from a study (use gather_create_content).

suggestion_id.description: The suggestion_id from gather_what_to_publish or gather_this_week.

name: gather_draft_article
title: Draft a suggested article
